service.description: The organization's production allocation policy (CostingPolicies): the row in effect now (the default, work-center hours and quantity, when none is), and every row newest first with its state. Requires ACCOUNTING_VIEW, ACCOUNTING_GL_POST, ACCOUNTING_ADMIN or PRODUCTION_COST_POST, or PRODUCTION_VIEW for the bases and methods without the rates and the variance account (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an organization the user does not work in (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

Change the organization's production allocation policy (CostingPolicies, finance administration): a new ProductionAllocationPolicy row from fromDate (now when empty) ending the row in effect, with its key fields audit-logged with the reason. A field not given keeps the previous row's value, an empty one clears it. Requires ACCOUNTING_ADMIN (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses another organization (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), no reason (CHANGE_REASON_REQUIRED), a stale form (POLICY_CHANGED: expectedFromDate is not the row in effect), a start before now, a second row at the same time, an unknown basis or method, a labor percentage basis without its percentage, a negative rate (POLICY_INVALID) and a variance account not active for the organization (ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: overheadRate
parameter.description: Per work-center hour, for a center with no overhead WorkCenterRate

service.description: The run and accounting day of a cost close.

parameter.name: accountingDate
parameter.description: The review's proposed day, else today

parameter.name: outputWeights
parameter.description: An output line's weight by its productionRunLineId, only where the effective policy allows explicit weights

service.description: Preview a production run's cost close (design-accounting ProductionCostClose; D12, R-SA-01): the events not yet in the GL absorbed by cost component (Dr WIP; Cr applied labor, applied machine and overhead, the outside-processing accrual), the variance of a subcontract bill whose match was unapplied reversed, the overhead of the effective ProductionAllocationPolicy (per work-center hour of the operations' machine runtime, else their labor, at the center's overhead rate; a percentage of labor; none), the scrap of issued material moved out of WIP (to its asset type's scrap account, or variance), the co-product split of the run's cost over its output lines and the residual WIP to production variance, the ledger lines, the findings and the inputFingerprint post#CostClose takes. After the run's close it previews the late events as an adjustment (R-SA-11). The findings block the post: a run not complete, unvalued events, movements that posted nothing, another currency, time on a timesheet not approved, a closed or missing fiscal period, an unmapped or inactive account, explicit weights the policy does not allow, a missing share or sales price, and nothing to adjust. Reads only. Requires ACCOUNTING_GL_POST or PRODUCTION_COST_POST (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: mode
parameter.description: close, or adjustment after the run's close

service.description: Post a previewed production cost close in one run-level transaction (design-accounting ProductionCostClose; D12, R-SA-11): one AttManufacturing AcctgTrans of the preview's ledger lines (none when nothing is left to post), the absorbed events marked posted at the close with it, a ProductionCostAllocation per absorbed event, overhead, scrap, output line share and variance under the policy row it applied, and, unless it is an adjustment after the close, the run's close recorded (productionCostClosedDate, its transaction and policy, the review PcrClosed) and the run closed through transition#ProductionOrder (WeComplete to WeClosed); the review notices are marked read. A retry with the same operation key answers the first post. Requires PRODUCTION_COST_POST (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), no preview (PREVIEW_REQUIRED), evidence changed since the preview (STALE_PREVIEW), any finding of the preview (by its code: PERIOD_CLOSED, TIME_UNAPPROVED, UNVALUED_EVENTS, RUN_NOT_COMPLETE, ...) and a posting the ledger refuses (POSTING_REFUSED).

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode CLOSED or ADJUSTED, workEffortId, mode, acctgTransId, productionCostAllocationIds, productionAllocationPolicyId, accountingDate, variance, statusId, revision, transitionResultCode, alreadyApplied

service.description: A production run's posted cost close: whether and when it was closed, its transaction and the policy row it applied, the review state, and each allocation (destination, component, line, share; amounts, accounts and transactions only with ACCOUNTING_VIEW, ACCOUNTING_GL_POST or PRODUCTION_COST_POST). Reads only. Requires one of those or PRODUCTION_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Return a requested cost review to production with a note (PcrReturned), so Manufacturing may request it again; the review notices are marked read. Requires PRODUCTION_COST_POST (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a review not requested (REVIEW_NOT_REQUESTED) and no note (NOTE_REQUIRED).

The production rows of the period close checklist (CloseServices.define#CloseCheck): the WIP accounts at the period's end against the production runs' WIP from their cost events and allocations, with the runs that hold WIP (PccProductionWip), and the runs completed by the period's end and not cost closed, with the closed runs that have cost events after their close (PccProductionCostClose). Refuses a user who may not read the organization's periods.
